attchmntText: Cerebra Integrated Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding recommendation of reappointment of Mr V Ranganathan as Managing Director of the company w.e.f. November 12, 2026.
voiceSummary: Cerebra Integrated Technologies Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the half year ended 30 September 2026. The Board recommended the re-appointment of Mr. V Ranganathan as Managing Director and Mr. P. Vishwamurthy as Whole-time Director and CFO for three years effective 1 January 2027. These appointments are subject to shareholder approval. The independent auditor issued a disclaimer of conclusion on the financial results. The auditor cited material uncertainties regarding the company's ability to continue as a going concern due to significant operating losses, workforce reduction, and a pending Corporate Insolvency and Resolution Process application before the NCLT Bengaluru bench. The auditor could not verify the carrying value of Rs. 142.63 crore in trade receivables, Rs. 5.98 crore in loans to a subsidiary, Rs. 100.28 crore in dues from an overseas party, and Rs. 20.30 crore in other advances.
